declaration.name: effect_render
declaration.description: Render an installed versioned effect from exact authorized source versions and hashes. For a reviewed request, every parameter and source must match approved_request from effects_catalog. Create actual silent MP4, PNG preview, immutable source JSON and ZIP. Same-input retries retain original files; removed completed outputs cannot be regenerated automatically. It does not publish externally or incur an extra AI fee.

declaration.name: request_input
declaration.description: Request essential missing authorized files or a supported marketing connection. The user chooses the resources. Finish this turn immediately after this tool; the same paid task and native thread continue after all inputs are provided. Never request credentials or invent access.

declaration.name: video_project_edit
declaration.description: Revise an own private video's full editable timeline at its expected_version and atomically queue the new version. Prior versions and finished artifacts remain unchanged. Copy a shared timeline into a new private project before changing it. A conflict requires reloading; do not blindly apply the edit again.

declaration.name: video_project_queue
declaration.description: Create a private, versioned script/storyboard/subtitle video project owned by this user and queue company composition. Use fixed authorized shared or own private PNG/WAV/MP3 versions and declared audio rights. Returns a queued render ID, not a finished file. Read status before claiming delivery. Does not synthesize voice or use another AI video service.
